blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Bureau of Internal Revenue (BIR) recorded double-digit revenue growth in September 2026, with gross collections reaching P203.581 billion, an increase of P20.056 billion or 10.93 percent compared with the same month last year, based on preliminary data as of Oct. 13, 2026. “Our taxpayers are doing their part, and our revenuers are doing theirs. By reaching out and helping taxpayers comply correctly and on time, we are showing that good taxpayer service and stronger revenue collections go hand in hand,” BIR Commissioner Charlito Martin R.
